core_categories: Mobility and Transfer Equipment; Home Care and Hospital Equipment; Pediatric and Special Needs Items; Physical Therapy and Rehabilitation Tools; Daily Living and Bathroom Safety Products; Wellness and Clinical Supplies
specialty_focus: Rehabmart is an online medical supply and assistive technology e-commerce platform founded in 1998 by occupational therapists. It connects patients, caregivers, hospitals, and schools with specialized therapeutic equipment, medical devices, and daily living aids. Its specialty focus includes a therapist-owned perspective with clinical insight for physical/occupational recovery, senior aging-in-place, and chronic care management, plus deep focus on pediatric developmental challenges and adaptive equipment. It also offers caregiver education through its Caregiver University resource.
